title: LIC HFL Junior Assistant Interview Letter 2026
vacancyDetails: 180 Junior Assistant posts under LIC HFL Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026.
qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university/institute, as prescribed in the official LIC HFL Junior Assistant 2026 advertisement.
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years as on the date specified in the official notification, with applicable relaxations.
applicationFee: As prescribed in the official LIC HFL Junior Assistant 2026 recruitment notification.
documentsRequired: Interview call letter, original photo ID, original educational certificates and other documents specified in the interview call letter.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.lichousing.com/careers
2. Open the Junior Assistant recruitment section
3. Check the interview/call letter notice for shortlisted candidates
4. Download the interview call letter when officially available
5. Verify the interview date, venue and reporting time
6. Attend the interview with the required original documents
shortDescription: LIC HFL Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026 is for 180 posts. The official notification scheduled the online examination for the first week of June 2026; an official 15 July 2026 interview-letter release date could not be verified.
content:
LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) issued the official recruitment notification for 180 Junior Assistant posts on 16 April 2026.

The official notification states that online registration was scheduled from 16 April 2026 to 30 April 2026 and that the Junior Assistant online examination was tentatively scheduled for the first week of June 2026. It also states that interview call letters would be made available on the LIC HFL website for shortlisted candidates.

The claimed 15 July 2026 interview call-letter release date and the claimed 06 June 2026 online examination date could not be independently verified from the official LIC HFL sources checked. Therefore, those dates have not been presented as authenticated dates.
statusNote: Interview call-letter release date not officially verified

importantDates.examDate: First week of June 2026 (tentative in official notification)
